endorsements.name: Inertia
endorsements.label: Introducing nmrcOS
endorsements.description: nmrcOS provides a secure environment for the modern hacker-type to call home, which would help protect the privacy and security of the users of the system. In addition, it provides a portable working environment for the hacker on the go— easy loading on simple hardware, no-nonsense command-line for uber control, yet usable by most people out of the box.
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 11
